title: Zesty Roasted Filipino Pinto Beans Halo Halo
description: A savory and comforting Filipino dish featuring roasted pinto beans in a halo halo form, wrapped in pandan leaves, perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: Soak the pinto beans in water for at least 8 hours or overnight.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Drain and rinse the pinto beans, then transfer them to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the pinto beans and sprinkle with minced garlic, chopped onion, salt, and black pepper.
Roast the pinto beans in the oven for 30 minutes or until they are tender and lightly browned.
Prepare the pandan leaves by washing and drying them with paper towels.
To assemble the halo halo, place a portion of the roasted pinto beans in the center of a pandan leaf, then fold the leaf to form a packet.
Serve the Zesty Roasted Filipino Pinto Beans Halo Halo warm or at room temperature.
